name: Aplitap Sidrena Cijena i Cjenik
author: aplitap

sections.description:
As of October 1, 2026, merchants in Croatia with their own website are required to, among other things:

  • display a “reference price” (sidrena cijena) alongside the regular selling price of each product – the price that applied on 10.09.2026,
  • publish a machine-readable price list (“cjenik”) of their products (in XML or CSV format) on their website.

This free plugin helps WooCommerce stores comply with both obligations, without any code changes or manual template editing.

Reference price (“Sidrena cijena”)

  • A field to enter the reference price on each product, and separately per variation for variable products
  • Automatic display below the regular price everywhere WooCommerce shows a product price (product page, shop, categories, related/upsell products, widgets)
  • Quick Edit support
  • Global switch to turn the display on or off
  • Customizable label text, font (family, weight, style, size, color), with separate font sizes for mobile and desktop

Price list (“Cjenik”)

  • Automatically generates an XML and/or CSV price list with the data required by the Decision: name, product code, brand, unit of measure, price per unit, retail price, special sale indicator, reference price, barcode, availability
  • Includes variations of variable products as separate line items
  • Automatically excludes products that are not visible on the website (with a manual override to include or exclude any individual product)
  • Regenerates daily before 8:00 (configurable time), and immediately whenever any product’s price changes
  • Archived, timestamped files are kept for at least 30 days (configurable)
  • Configurable CSV delimiter, email notification if generation fails
  • A data preview table inside the admin screen, before downloading the file

Note: The Decision on publishing price lists (NN 101/2026) specifies which data the price list must contain, but does not prescribe an exact CSV column order or XML schema. This plugin is a technical aid based on a publicly available interpretation of the regulation – we recommend checking with your accountant or lawyer for your specific situation.

Requirements

  • WordPress with an active WooCommerce plugin
  • PHP 7.4 or newer
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New Plugin
  3. Click Upload Plugin, select the downloaded zip file, click Install Now
  4. After installation, click Activate Plugin
  5. A new menu item “Sidrena cijena Aplitap” will appear in the left sidebar, with tabs for the reference price, the price list, and information about Aplitap
  6. For each product (Products → edit product → General tab) enter the reference price; for the price list, set your outlet label under the price list tab
sections.faq:
Does the plugin work without WooCommerce?

No – the plugin requires an active WooCommerce installation. If WooCommerce is not active, an admin notice is shown and the plugin’s functionality does not run.

Do I need to enter the reference price manually for every product?

Yes, it is entered manually per product (or per variation for variable products), since WordPress/WooCommerce does not keep a price history by default.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes – both the reference price and the price list support separate values per variation.

Can I exclude a specific product from the price list?

Yes – on each product (and in Quick Edit) there is a “Price list visibility” dropdown with the options Automatic / Always include / Always exclude.

Where is the price list published?

Files are saved under wp-content/uploads/cjenik/ and must be publicly accessible – please make sure a security plugin, firewall, or Cloudflare is not blocking automated tools from reading them.

Is this legal advice?

No. The plugin is a technical aid based on a publicly available interpretation of the Decision on publishing price lists (NN 101/2026). We recommend checking with an accountant or lawyer before 1.10.2026.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • Updated tags for better discoverability
  • Rewrote the short description for clarity

1.3.0

  • Declared compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS), Cart & Checkout blocks, and the Product Block Editor
  • Updated tags for better discoverability

1.2.0

  • Renamed the plugin to lead with the Aplitap brand
  • Moved dynamic CSS to wp_enqueue_style/wp_add_inline_style instead of an inline style tag
  • Removed the duplicate “Tested up to” header from the main plugin file
  • Rewrote this readme in English

1.1.0

  • Added an “About” tab with a short agency description and a feedback/suggestion form

1.0.0

  • Initial public release
  • Reference price: field per product and per variation, display below the regular price site-wide, Quick Edit support, customizable text/font/color with separate mobile and desktop settings
  • Price list: automatic XML/CSV generation per NN 101/2026, with configurable generation time, format, delimiter, archive retention, error email notifications, and manual product visibility control
  • Settings organized into tabs under a dedicated admin menu item

short_description: Adds legally required reference prices and machine-readable price lists to your Croatian WooCommerce store — mandatory from 1 October 2026.
